name: Maidenly feast
source:
Camellia daydreams of romance on her way to her new job. She hopes to meet a beautiful woman who likes her back, but for now, she has to worry about not messing up. Ivy, the head maid, is a kind and lovely woman who seems to like her back. Is it possible for love to blossom between them?

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/maidenly-feast]itch.io[/url]]
